digest.component_or_area: pytest test suite temporary directory management
propositions: Nested pytest sessions executing tests with temporary fixtures without a private --basetemp parameter join the user-global numbered temp root and delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories at child session finish

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py and tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py launch executing nested pytest children that allocate pytest's shared numbered root instead of an isolated child-specific basetemp, allowing parent-unowned cleanup to delete sibling temp trees

Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root; pytest_sessionfinish triggers this cleanup only when _basetemp is not None, making executing nested children without explicit --basetemp vulnerable to shared-root deletion

The repair adds parent-owned tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest basetemp to the engine test and tmp_path/standalone-pytest basetemp to the scripts-import test, isolating each child's cleanup to its assigned directory
All direct subprocess pytest launchers must either pass --basetemp (parent-owned), use pytester helper injection, or execute with --collect-only to avoid shared-root cleanup collisions
A held-out regression test in tests/unit/test_test_suite_store_isolation.py verifies both repaired children preserve cleanup-eligible sentinel files byte-for-byte when isolated basetemp is applied
